# ZEECOM SOLUTION — Full Architectural & Technical Reference

## Enterprise Engineering Architecture

### 1. AI-Powered Physical Surveillance & Access Control
- Edge AI optical analytics: ANPR/LPR (Automatic License Plate Recognition), perimeter intrusion tripwires, dwell-time anomalies, object classification.
- Biometric Readers: Dual-lens anti-spoofing facial recognition (<0.2s verification), optical fingerprint, RFID/MIFARE, Bluetooth/NFC mobile credentials.
- Security Integration: ONVIF Profile S/G/T/M compliance, RTSP direct streaming, integration with fire alarms and automated facility lockdown relays.

### 2. VoIP Unified Communications & CRM Integration
- PBX Infrastructure: Asterisk / FreePBX / FreeSWITCH SIP core with TLS/SRTP encryption.
- CRM Integrations: HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, Bitrix24, Microsoft Dynamics 365, custom REST API webhooks.
- Call Flow Features: Automatic Call Distribution (ACD), Skill-Based Routing, Interactive Voice Response (IVR), Queue Callback, Call Whisper/Barge, Speech-to-Text Transcription.

### 3. IP-Audio Public Address & Intercom Systems
- Audio Transports: Dante, AES67, SIP/RTP multicast streaming over Gigabit Ethernet.
- Endpoint Hardware: IP ceiling speakers (15W/30W PoE+), outdoor weatherproof horn speakers (120dB+ SPL), two-way emergency push-to-talk call boxes.
- Zone Management: Flexible software-defined zone matrix, background ambient audio scheduling, priority emergency override broadcast.
